pencereler.0-5: In a photo formation, an F-104 fighter collided with the giant XB-70 bomber. Both
pencereler.5-12: aircraft crashed, and two pilots were killed. Five jets were flying in close formation. They were being photographed for
pencereler.12-20: their engine maker. The F-104 drifted into the bomber's wing. It rolled over the XB-70 and exploded. The Valkyrie lost its tail
pencereler.20-30: and crashed. Only one XB-70 remains, in a museum.

segmentler.metin: The XB-70 Valkyrie was hit by an F-104 during a photo formation.
It took only flying in close formation for publicity photos.
So how could flying in close formation for publicity photos do this?
The answer is a chase fighter drifting into the bomber in tight formation — and it is why the crash raised questions about publicity flights with test aircraft.
